purpose: Determine whether released IBDverse methods, metadata and regional genetic information enable a qualified PSC-PRKD2 shared-signal comparison.
scope: Step 1 only: public source/code/model audit of original classical and intermediate blood monocytes. No researcher contact, access application, laboratory work, extra cell-state screen or new prediction calls.
source_families: Public IBDVerse-sc-eQTL-code and explicitly referenced mapping/colocalisation/LD pipelines
BioStudies S-BSST2922 and E-MTAB-16986 inventories and relevant metadata
Already inventoried base_eQTLs ZIP gene-level and independent-hit tables for the two fixed contexts
Directly linked public regional LD or complete component files, if actually present
questions: What are the observed donor counts and exact fixed/selected covariates in each released context?
How do the deployed software, expression/genotype processing, variant filters and standard-error conventions map to the released statistics?
Does the source provide signed study-matched LD/covariance with exact variant and allele order, or complete original signal vectors?
Do full gene-level/independent-hit tables clarify PRKD2 signal count and conditional associations?
Which PSC-side sample/covariance requirements remain even if RNA-side details are recovered?
qualification: Keep directly observed metadata, executed-run records, public configuration defaults, source code behavior and numerical inference distinct. A configuration or inferred residual df alone does not establish the actual donor set or deployed model. Independent lead tables, LD clump membership and an external-reference LD panel do not substitute for complete signal components or adequate covariance. Retain prior 90-percent marginal/component coverage requirements and all PSC-side limitations. No new shared-cause posterior unless all required inputs and model assumptions are qualified before that analysis is frozen.
outputs: Pinned public sources and repository commits, full inventory accountability, evidence table distinguishing resolved and unresolved fields, extracted PRKD2 source rows where useful, independent verification and reproduction instructions, explicit ready/not-ready decision with exact remaining inputs. Preserve all previous scientific outputs.
